lines: Take away my sight and hearing
I wish only my body heat could become the universe
The world is full of lies
If you peer through the secret door
Everyone cries alone like a child
Smile and say that everything we were born into is right
I will deem only you as good
My god, I will give you to no one
My god, being drawn in
My god, I cannot tell anyone
I will share the secret only with you
I love you
Like an unhealthy coloring book in a single favorite hue
My whole life has been completely taken over
The bewildered depths of my pupils
Drink it all down, even if it’s deadly poison
Because everyday life is safe, I only have to lose myself
Snap my fingers and erase everything that gets in the way
Let’s create a country for just the two of us
My god, heating up
I want to become the justice that shapes you
My god, I have been waiting forever, even today
When I lift my face in the dim room
You smile
A vision that warps normally
If the unbreakable spell is passed by mouth
So that emptiness would vanish completely
Hold me tight until it hurts
Pain and pleasure are so much alike
Let’s dream in the darkness
My god, no one can break it
My god, a certain illusion
My god, no matter how much I yearn
I am only swallowed by your eyes
Both happiness and misfortune are left to the button in my hand
I love you
